title: 潛盾掘進導向控制
summary: 本課聚焦把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與坐標基準」與「方位精度與遠距傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control networks and coordinate datum" and "Azimuth precision over distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與坐標基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control networks and coordinate datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制網與坐標基準」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control networks and coordinate datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道導航從地表控制延伸到洞內測站再到機器目標，任何基準轉換錯誤都會沿鏈傳遞。坐標系、軸向、單位及高程需在同一版本，畫面上的小偏差只有在基準正確時才有意義。 假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制網與坐標基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Navigation transfers surface control through underground stations to machine targets, propagating datum errors along the chain. Coordinate frame, axes, units and elevation must share a version; small displayed offsets matter only within the correct datum. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise. A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Control networks and coordinate datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「控制網與坐標基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Control networks and coordinate datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與坐標基準
knowledge.text: 隧道導航從地表控制延伸到洞內測站再到機器目標，任何基準轉換錯誤都會沿鏈傳遞。坐標系、軸向、單位及高程需在同一版本，畫面上的小偏差只有在基準正確時才有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Navigation transfers surface control through underground stations to machine targets, propagating datum errors along the chain. Coordinate frame, axes, units and elevation must share a version; small displayed offsets matter only within the correct datum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與坐標基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control networks and coordinate datum" is correct?
options: 坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。
隧道導航從地表控制延伸到洞內測站再到機器目標，任何基準轉換錯誤都會沿鏈傳遞。
每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。
optionsEn: Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel.
Navigation transfers surface control through underground stations to machine targets, propagating datum errors along the chain.
Angular errors in every survey segment are necessarily independent and cancel each other.
quiz.explanation: 隧道導航從地表控制延伸到洞內測站再到機器目標，任何基準轉換錯誤都會沿鏈傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Navigation transfers surface control through underground stations to machine targets, propagating datum errors along the chain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與坐標基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control networks and coordinate datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制網與坐標基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Control networks and coordinate datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與坐標基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control networks and coordinate datum", which statement holds?
options: 從目標點算刀盤中心只需平移，不必考慮機身旋轉。
只要能回到設計中心線，就不必檢查組環曲率與止水限制。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Transforming a target to cutterhead center requires translation only, without machine rotation.
Returning to the design centerline removes the need to check ring curvature and seal limits.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與坐標基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control networks and coordinate datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制網與坐標基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Control networks and coordinate datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄控制網與坐標基準的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for control networks and coordinate datum. Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。
knowledge.textEn: Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄控制網與坐標基準的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for control networks and coordinate datum. Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與坐標基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control networks and coordinate datum"?
options: 以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
把受折射影響的讀值平滑後就能恢復真實機器姿態。
optionsEn: Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Smoothing refracted observations restores the true machine attitude automatically.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換、尺度和高程，保存轉換矩陣與版本；測量主管須確認設計線形、機器與竣工資料使用同一基準，不能只比對某一重合原點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check transformations, scale and elevation at independent controls and retain matrices and versions; the survey lead confirms a common datum for design alignment, machine and as-built data rather than checking one coincident origin alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與坐標基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control networks and coordinate datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制網與坐標基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Control networks and coordinate datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。
knowledge.textEn: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與坐標基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control networks and coordinate datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。
每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later.
Angular errors in every survey segment are necessarily independent and cancel each other.
quiz.explanation: 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 方位精度與遠距傳遞：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「方位精度與遠距傳遞」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Azimuth precision over distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長隧道方向誤差會隨距離放大，角度精度與位置精度必須分別規劃。多次測站轉接可能累積相關偏差，單次儀器精度不能直接當作全線貫通精度，需用網平差和獨立方向控制。 假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方位精度與遠距傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Angular error grows into lateral position error along a long tunnel. Repeated station transfers can accumulate correlated bias, so one instrument rating is not a breakthrough-accuracy estimate; network adjustment and independent orientation are required. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error. Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Azimuth precision over distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Angular errors in every survey segment are necessarily independent and cancel each other." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Angular errors in every survey segment are necessarily independent and cancel each other. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「方位精度與遠距傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Azimuth precision over distance" is correct?
options: 每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。

steps.title: 方位精度與遠距傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Azimuth precision over distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方位精度與遠距傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Azimuth precision over distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 方位精度與遠距傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Azimuth precision over distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方位精度與遠距傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Azimuth precision over distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄方位精度與遠距傳遞的資料來源與適用條件。以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for azimuth precision over distance. Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。
knowledge.textEn: Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「方位精度與遠距傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Azimuth precision over distance"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以正倒鏡、多測回及獨立方向基準核對方位，將設站、對中與角度不確定分項傳播；測量工程師應檢查相關性，不能把每測段誤差都當互相抵消。
兩個共用錯誤基準的感測器融合後可以消除共同偏差。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately.
Fusing two sensors sharing an incorrect datum eliminates their common bias.

quiz.explanationEn: Check azimuth with face reversals, repeated sets and independent direction references, propagating station, centering and angular uncertainties separately; survey engineers assess correlation rather than assuming segment errors cancel each other. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 方位精度與遠距傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Azimuth precision over distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方位精度與遠距傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Azimuth precision over distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一測段的角度誤差必定獨立而且可以互相抵消。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Angular errors in every survey segment are necessarily independent and cancel each other." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。
knowledge.textEn: Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「方位精度與遠距傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Gyro orientation is automatic truth needing no calibration or thermal-drift consideration.
Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce.
quiz.explanation: 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
